claim: One click opens a filled cart-loop practice with sample history.
where: landing first-screen action, README demo link
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; click the first-screen sample action and assert /?demo=1, the demo banner, seeded hypothesis, and sample history

claim: Reset demo restores the shipped sample, and leaving the demo clears its keys.
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; edit and reset, assert the shipped sample, then leave through Home and assert no localStorage keys remain

claim: The extension records a hypothesis, test output, fix, and clue in a debugging receipt.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; load the packaged MV3 extension, complete all four fields, save, and inspect the receipt

claim: The extension can delete all saved receipts after a specific confirmation.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; save a receipt, open history, accept the named delete-all confirmation, and assert the empty state and zero count

claim: The practice asks for a testable hypothesis before test output or a fix.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the test field is absent until the hypothesis is locked

claim: Your entries stay in your browser.
where: landing facts, privacy page, extension footer, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; complete a receipt while recording requests and inspect demo-only localStorage keys

claim: The website demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; wait for service worker, reload once under control, set offline, and reload

claim: A completed receipt exports as Markdown.
where: demo and extension receipt action, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; finish the seeded trace and assert the downloaded Markdown contains all four sections

claim: The extension is free to download.
sandbox: built site; request the public extension zip without login or payment and verify a valid ZIP signature

claim: The extension does not read open files or tabs, and it does not block coding assistants.
sandbox: built extension; inspect the MV3 manifest and assert storage is the only requested permission

claim: The extension does not generate code or answers.
sandbox: built extension; assert it has no host permissions and its bundle has no model gateway or model endpoint

claim: The product has no analytics or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load landing and demo, record all requests, and inspect every runtime script source
